## Phase 2 — implementation notes

**Exporter (`exports/src/exports/transparency.py`):**

- Row schema renamed `sig.transparency-sources/1` → `sig.source-row/1`
  (`SOURCE_RECORD_SCHEMA`) — the artifact's own name now states the source
  definition (one registry row = one source); `column_registry.py`
  descriptions updated in step.
- `_lifecycle_state` gained the `withdrawn` hook: a registry row carrying a
  `withdrawn` flag or `[withdrawal]` sub-table lands `withdrawn` FIRST in the
  precedence order — the state was vocabulary-only before (D-J3-5 records no
  signal today; the hook makes the published precedence real, not
  asserted-but-dead). Refused (`compact_status = permission_declined`) and
  gated stay distinct per K9 §3.2 predicates.
- `source_record`: the schedule facet is now a three-class exclusive —
  `scheduled | not_scheduled | one_time_load`; a one-time seed is never also
  counted `scheduled` (caught by the new test, fixed before commit).
- `source_counts` emits `partition_sum{definition, observed, expected, holds}`
  — the fail-closed producer assert is also recorded IN the released artifact
  so any consumer verifies coverage without re-running the gate. Every
  attribute is `{definition, count}` (or `{definition, by_lane}` for lanes —
  the lane map gained its named definition).
- Anomaly union widened to `executions ∪ captures ∪ claims ∪ site records ∪
  cadence declarations` − registry ids: a scheduled-but-unregistered id
  carries ops data and is listed, never counted.

**Web (`web/`):**

- `web/src/lib/source-counts.ts` (new): the `sig.source-row/1` /
  `sig.source-counts/1` types, fail-loud validators (`isSourceCountsDoc`
  refuses a wrong `precedence.order` or a `partition_sum` that does not
  hold), `recomputeSourceCounts` — the TS mirror of the exporter's
  `recompute_counts` — and the committed fixture pair built through
  `buildCountsDoc` (derived, never hand-written; the builder fails closed on
  a row escaping the partition).
- `data.ts`: `getSourceCounts()` / `getSourceRows()` — fixtures mode returns
  the committed pair; export mode reads `<exportDir>/transparency/…` and
  fails LOUD on missing/malformed. `getReleaseArtifactPayload` serves both
  documents so `/artifact/transparency/counts.json` resolves.
- `index.astro`: the stale "N sources tracked for freshness" headline (the
  K9 §3.3 "178") is replaced by `attributes.site_records.count` —
  "sources with published site records" — a `<Figure>` pointing at
  `transparency/counts.json` `/attributes/site_records/count`.
- `HowWeKnowThis.astro`: the stale "Independent sources" label (K9 §3.3
  "218") becomes the named predicate. Site scope reads
  `lifecycle.published.count` from `transparency/counts.json` — the release
  artifact, never a second counting path. Page-scoped modules keep their
  per-surface count under the emitted `source_label` ("Detectors" on the
  research queue); `provenance.ts` gained the optional field and the
  one-liner now says "contributing source(s)".
- `sources.astro`: new "How SIG counts a source" block (`#how-counted`) —
  the universe count, the six-state lifecycle partition rendered in
  precedence order with each state label + emitted predicate definition +
  count `<Figure>`, the orthogonal attribute counts (rights, run records,
  scheduled, site records), and the anomaly box listing `anomalies.ids`
  verbatim ("Identifiers that are not sources"). Eleven new figures, all
  manifest-listed `transparency/counts.json` pointers.
- `search.astro` / `empty.ts` / freshness intro: "registry sources"
  terminology throughout.
- `build-fixture-export.ts`: emits `transparency/counts.json` +
  `transparency/sources.json` (manifest-listed) and — filling the latent
  P35.39 gap — `dictionary.json`, so a fixture-only `SIG_DATA_SOURCE=export`
  build exercises every artifact-reading surface. Provenance analytics
  payloads now carry `source_label` per surface (site/corrections/dossiers:
  "Sources with published claims"; queue: "Detectors") — mirrored in the
  real exporter's `analytics.py` `_provenance`.
- `root-absolute-paths-baseline.json` + `figure-numerals-allowlist.json`:
  reasoned exemptions only — JSON-pointer literals are not links (per-file,
  per-token, counted); the two bare `0`s are the artifact's own definition
  text (`claims_inserted > 0`) rendered verbatim beside its named count.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: Unreleased entry recording the copy/predicate changes
  (public-behaviour path set touched).

**Coverage matrix** (`docs/build/COVERAGE_MATRIX.csv`): SIG-TRANSP-002/026/027
MISSING → `MET-ENGINEERED(D-R10-PUBLISH-1)`, covered+tested, evidence +
tests columns, re-routed to the unlanded publish row P35.63 (SIG-ENG-041);
SIG-TRANSP-001 gets the appended also-note only (owner stays P36.48).

## Phase 3 — self-review

Code pass:

- `source_counts` emits `precedence.order` == `LIFECYCLE_STATES` and the
  partition assertion runs BEFORE the doc is built — a malformed row can
  never ship. `partition_sum.holds` is computed (not hard-coded `true`).
- `recompute_counts` and the TS `recomputeSourceCounts` agree field-for-field
  (asserted by tests on both sides); `buildCountsDoc` throws when the
  partition does not cover — same fail-closed posture as the exporter.
- Anomaly set is the full data-bearing union minus registry ids; anomalies
  can never land in `sources.json` (rows are emitted per `registry_map`
  key only) — verified by test.
- The gated/S-11 row path still renders registry-only rows for
  gated/refused/withdrawn/unknown/restricted lanes; `lifecycle_state`,
  `lane`, `status_flags`, `cadence`, `published_sites` ride on gated rows so
  `counts.json` recomputes from `sources.json` alone (SIG-TRANSP-D27).
- Web figures: every rendered numeral on /sources/ + home is a `<Figure>`
  with a manifest-listed artifact, pointer, definition link and resolvable
  breakdown anchor — `check-figures` green in both data modes.
- No `ingestion_permitted` flip, no spine write, no HG gate, no production
  mutation — exporter/web code only. No secrets.

## Phase 4 — gap analysis vs contract

Contract re-read (full file, 2026-10-20). AC-by-AC:

- **Engineered AC** — `sig.source-row/1` lands (schema rename + emitted
  rows); the partition function + anomaly list + partition counts emit;
  stale copy replaced on home / HowWeKnowThis / search / freshness empty
  state / `/sources/` counting block. `make check` running (see Phase 5).
- **Fixture-verified AC** — `test_p35_40_source_counts.py` (16 tests) +
  `web/tests/unit/source-counts.test.ts` (15 tests): one row per registry
  id, exactly-one-state partition, precedence first-match ×3, partition
  fail-closed, anomalies listed-by-id + uncovered, every count named,
  emitted-vs-recomputed parity, withdrawn/one_time_load definitions,
  empty-registry behaviour, export-seam missing/malformed loud failures.
  `check-figures` is the "no numeral outside a named-definition figure"
  crawl — green on fixtures AND export-mode dist.
- **Staging-verified AC** — reported at fixture-verified: no staging env
  exists; the fixture-export harness produces a real on-disk bundle whose
  bytes the export-mode build + figure check consume (the closest local
  leg, same pattern as P35.39's recorded layer).
- **Live / Public / Human ACs** — none run: per contract no such leg exists
  here (corrected counts ship
  with the next release; no gate; D-J3-5 read as recorded).
- **K9 §3.3 mapping** — 178 → `attributes.site_records.count` (home);
  218 → `lifecycle.published.count` (HowWeKnowThis site scope);
  219-class unregistered ids → `anomalies.ids`; the universe →
  `universe.count` on `/sources/`. No old numeral survives beside the new
  ones (checked `web/src` + built dist for the stale strings).
- **Out of scope respected** — no `/sources/` table rework (P36.48), no
  anomaly registration/removal, no freshness semantics change (P35.41),
  no permission/gate flips.
- **Size** — ~760 changed lines + ~1,155 new test/module lines, well under
  the 3,000 budget excluding fixtures.
